title: UI/UX Improvements for Auto-Claude-Marketing - Ultrathink Edition
description: Comprehensive UI/UX improvements based on Playwright testing with 7-dimensional analysis (Psychological, Technical, Accessibility, Scalability, Performance, Security, DX).

modalBlockingIssue.psychological: User frustration when navigation is blocked - creates feeling of being 'stuck' in the application
modalBlockingIssue.technical: Radix Dialog uses Portal with z-index 50 and overlay that intercepts all pointer events when open. Multiple dialogs in App.tsx may auto-open on page load (onboarding, init, version warning).
modalBlockingIssue.accessibility: Modal blocking navigation prevents keyboard users from navigating freely
modalBlockingIssue.scalability: Modal state management is fragmented across multiple useState hooks in App.tsx
modalBlockingIssue.performance: Multiple dialog re-renders due to useEffect dependency array issues
modalBlockingIssue.dx: Difficult to debug which modal is open - no centralized dialog state management

navigationTextIssue.psychological: Confusing label 'Kanban BoardK' breaks mental model of clean navigation
navigationTextIssue.technical: Playwright test shows truncated text - likely kbd element rendering or i18n issue
navigationTextIssue.accessibility: Screen readers may announce 'Kanban BoardK' instead of proper label
navigationTextIssue.scalability: Navigation item rendering is inlined in Sidebar.tsx - should be extracted
navigationTextIssue.dx: Navigation pattern needs reusable component for consistency

psychological.userFrustration: Modal blocking navigation creates 'stuck' feeling - users lose control of the application
psychological.mentalModel: Users expect navigation to always be available and accessible
psychological.trust: Broken navigation reduces trust in application reliability and professionalism
psychological.cognitiveLoad: Truncated text ('Kanban BoardK') increases cognitive load and confusion
recommendations: Always keep navigation accessible - avoid modals that block nav
Provide clear visual feedback for all user actions
Use familiar UI patterns (don't reinvent navigation)
Minimize modal usage for critical navigation flows
Add loading states to prevent user uncertainty

technical.rootCause: Multiple useState hooks for modals + useEffect auto-triggers + browser mock state inconsistency
technical.radixDialog: Dialog uses Portal with z-index 50 and full-screen overlay that blocks pointer events when open
technical.stateManagement: Fragmented modal state across 13+ useState hooks in App.tsx alone - no centralized tracking
technical.reactEffects: useEffect dependency array issues cause excessive re-renders (tab restore warning)
technical.webPreviewMode: Browser mock may not match Electron behavior - state inconsistencies
recommendations: Implement centralized modal store with Zustand for predictable state
Add modal stack for priority management (only one modal at a time)
Fix useEffect dependencies with useMemo/useCallback to prevent loops
Add modal lifecycle debugging (console.log on mount/unmount)
Ensure web preview mode has consistent initial state

accessibility.wcagCompliance: Currently WCAG 2.1 partially compliant - need full AA
accessibility.colorContrast: Secondary text rgb(92, 105, 116) may fail 4.5:1 on some backgrounds
accessibility.keyboardNav: Tab works but focus indicators need improvement for visibility
accessibility.screenReader: Need to verify with NVDA/JAWS - i18n may affect announcement order
recommendations: Enforce 44x44px minimum touch targets with CSS utilities
Create automated color contrast validation tool in build process
Add focus-visible styling for keyboard users (outline)
Test with real screen readers (NVDA on Windows, VoiceOver on Mac)
Ensure i18n translations preserve accessibility (shortcuts announced separately)
Add ARIA live regions for dynamic content updates

scalability.currentIssue: Navigation items inlined in Sidebar.tsx - not reusable
scalability.designTokens: Hardcoded values throughout - prevents consistent theming
scalability.patternLibrary: No centralized component documentation - knowledge silos
scalability.maintenance: Adding new nav items requires editing Sidebar.tsx directly
recommendations: Extract NavigationItem component for reusability
Create design token system (apps/frontend/src/shared/theme/)
Build component documentation site (Storybook or similar)
Establish UI contribution guidelines for team
Create UI kit library for consistency across projects

Set performance budget in Lighthouse CI

security.csp: Consider adding Content-Security-Policy headers for production

Add CSP headers for production build
Review .env files to ensure no secrets in frontend
Add Subresource Integrity (SRI) for external scripts

implementationStrategy.approach: Parallel execution where possible, fix critical blockers first (modal issue)

testingStrategy.unitTests: Vitest for component logic (buttons, navigation, modal state)
testingStrategy.integrationTests: Playwright for user flows (navigation, calendar, modals)
testingStrategy.accessibilityTests: axe-core or WAVE for automated a11y testing
testingStrategy.visualRegression: Percy or Chromatic for visual diffs (before/after)
testingStrategy.performanceTests: Lighthouse CI for metrics (Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices)
testingStrategy.manualTesting: Exploratory testing on real devices (Windows, Mac, mobile)

rollbackPlan.then: Revert changes, use git worktree to isolate fix attempt
rollbackPlan.alternative: Implement less invasive fix (add ESC key listener to close modal)

notes: Testing was done with Playwright browser automation (3 test scripts in /tmp/)
Web server runs on localhost:3000 via 'bun run dev:web' (PRIMARY development method)
All screenshots saved to /tmp/ during testing (auto-marketing-*.png)
Modal issue is CRITICAL - blocks all navigation on first render
Use ultrathink analysis (7 dimensions) for all architectural decisions
Document patterns and lessons learned for future maintenance
Consider Electron desktop app differences when testing (web preview vs Electron)
